candidate_relations.reason: The mass invaded from serosa into myometrium as CD99/KIT/cyclin-D1–positive small round cells, a Ewing phenotype rather than undifferentiated uterine sarcoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: undifferentiated uterine sarcoma vs Ewing phenotype

candidate_relations.reason: Desmoplastic small round cell tumor is typically keratin- and WT1-positive, whereas this tumor is keratin-negative, WT1-negative, and CD99-positive.
The 14-cm retroperitoneal mass encasing the external iliac artery is a retroperitoneal sarcoma by site but not specified as Ewing sarcoma.
Uterine carcinosarcoma is a biphasic keratin-positive epithelial-mesenchymal tumor, not sheets of CD99-positive small round cells with rosettes.
Endometrial stromal sarcoma arises in endometrium and is not this serosal-to-myometrial CD99/KIT-positive small-round-cell tumor.
Metastatic colorectal cancer would be keratin-positive adenocarcinoma, not a keratin-negative CD99-positive small-round-cell sarcoma.

case_quality_flags: No EWSR1 or other fusion result is provided; Ewing sarcoma is inferred from CD99/KIT/cyclin-D1 small-round-cell histology.
